name: Korah
summary: A Levite who led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron, claiming the whole congregation was holy. The earth opened and swallowed him and his followers, though his own children did not die.

key_moments.title: Rising Against Moses
key_moments.description: Korah, with Dathan, Abiram and 250 well-known leaders, gathered against Moses and Aaron. They said all the people were holy, so Moses and Aaron had no right to set themselves above the rest.

key_moments.title: Gathers the Congregation Against Moses
key_moments.description: Moses told Korah and his company to bring censers with incense before the LORD, who would show whom He had chosen. Korah gathered the whole congregation at the tabernacle door, and the LORD's glory appeared to them all.

key_moments.title: Swallowed by the Earth
key_moments.description: The ground split open and swallowed Korah's men and their households, and the LORD sent fire that burned up the 250 who offered incense. Yet Korah's children did not die.
